text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Kitasan Black and Brusquemente pushed 
their unique running styles to the 
absolute limit, giving it everything they 
had, and burned out completely...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their Classic Road, which had been cut 
short midway, had finally reached its 
completion here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, it is discovered that 
Brusqueman has been injured. Carrying her 
hopes as well, the next challenge is the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
